# NFG

> NFG publishes tools and ready-to-install packages for Anvil Empires players.

## Localized project index

- [English](https://nfg-system.online/en/)
- [Русский](https://nfg-system.online/ru/)
- [Español](https://nfg-system.online/es/)
- [Deutsch](https://nfg-system.online/de/)
- [Français](https://nfg-system.online/fr/)
- [Português (Brasil)](https://nfg-system.online/pt-br/)
- [简体中文](https://nfg-system.online/zh-cn/)
- [日本語](https://nfg-system.online/ja/)
- [한국어](https://nfg-system.online/ko/)
- [Türkçe](https://nfg-system.online/tr/)

## Products

- [Anvil Planner](https://anvil-planner.nfg-system.online/)
- [Anvil Empires Russian localization](https://github.com/nullith2/anvil-empires-russian/releases/download/v1.0.1/Anvil-Empires-Russian-v1.0.1-steam-build-24619810.zip)
- [Anvil Empires Spanish localization](https://github.com/Aneonfas/anvil-empires-localizations/releases/download/es-v0.1.0/Anvil-Empires-Spanish-v0.1.0-steam-build-24619810.zip)
- [Anvil Forge Helper](https://github.com/nullith2/Anvil-forge-helper)
- [NFG Hub](https://github.com/Aneonfas/nfg-hub/releases/download/v0.3.0/NFG-Hub-v0.3.0-win-x64.zip)

## Notes

- The Russian and Spanish localization links point to ready release archives.
- NFG Hub is the Windows catalog and installer for supported NFG packages.
- Canonical page metadata and sitemap.xml remain the authoritative discovery sources.
